text:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — Acme POC is ready to convert. Procurement is asking for a signed 'commitment letter' that binds KMS handling to our HSM. They flagged it as blocker. Anyone able to advise legal/security + quick signer path? :warning:

josh_legal: Can you paste the exact requested language? We need to see the redline to advise if we can accept or need amendments.

maria_sales: here's excerpt from procurement email:
```
"Our org requires that all encryption keys for customer data be stored in a customer-controlled KMS/HSM and that the vendor provide a legally binding commitment that keys will never be exported without written consent."
```

alex_ops: Tech note: our Hosted API uses Redwood-managed keys by default. Dedicated can use customer KMS in supported clouds. On-prem can definitely meet HSM requirement but needs a deployment switch and timeline.

indra_security: Two pieces: 1) we can provide an attestation for HSM usage and key policies; 2) procurement wants contractual guarantee. Legal will need to scope what "never exported" means wrt backups/DR.

josh_legal: We can't accept absolute "never exported" language. Propose compromise: "keys are stored in customer-managed KMS/HSM; vendor will not export keys except pursuant to documented disaster recovery procedures and with customer's written approval." Will loop in Counsels.

sam_engineer: If we need customer KMS in Hosted, that's a product change. For Dedicated/PV we can deliver immediately. ETA for Hosted KMS option is ~8 weeks (engineering runway + infra).

maria_sales: Customer prefers Hosted for onboarding speed. Can we do a short-term workaround: Dedicated trial and then migrate to Hosted once feature ships?

alex_ops: Yes, offer Dedicated reserved pool for POC. Add a migration plan in order form (dates + rollback). We'll need PO and a signed commitment on migration windows.

josh_legal: I'll prepare a redline for the MSA/DPA with the suggested compromise. Need procurement contact + their signed commitment letter draft. @maria_sales loop them in please.

maria_sales: looping procurement: @procurement_acme (copied). I'll attach PO draft and ask for their legal contact. :email:

deploy-bot: Ticket created: SVC-4218 "Acme POC - KMS commitment & Dedicated migration plan". Assignee: alex_ops. https://redwood.internal/tickets/SVC-4218

indra_security: Also: we need to answer a short security questionnaire (one pager) — I'll assign it to @sam_engineer for the infra section.

sam_engineer: Got it, will fill infra Q by EOD tomorrow.

maria_sales: Thanks all. Goal: have signed MSA redline + PO + migration plan by EOD Fri. :calendar:
